verdicts.reason: The two layouts are almost the same, and both have the same faults. 'WEEKEND ONLY' sits far above '20% off', with a big empty gap between them. The body copy and the Shop Sale button form a separate middle column that is out of line with the headline, so the headline, copy and button don't read as one group. The legal line is shrunk to an unreadable size and left floating under the product circle. The only difference is that B's middle column sits slightly closer to the headline (x≈256 vs 293); that doesn't fix the scattered grouping in either.
